content: <thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 268.1939, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 267.1867 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈ 20 % M+1, ≈ 2 % M+2) matches a composition with about 19 carbons. The formula C₁₉H₂₃O fits the exact mass (267.1749 Da) within typical instrument error and reproduces the observed isotopic distribution. Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C₁₉H₂₃O.
